title: Read and summarise a Notion page with AI
h1: ask ai to read a notion page for you
description: Have a bot read a Notion page and turn it into a summary or checklist, without changing a word of it.
keyword: read notion page markdown with ai
answer: your bot can fetch a notion page as markdown and use that text for a summary, comparison or checklist in your chat. paste its link or have the bot find it by title first. retrieval is read only. the important check is completeness: the response says whether text was truncated and which blocks could not be rendered, so a successful fetch may still leave gaps.
og_line: page text, with its gaps made visible.
what:
this gives the bot a text version of a specified page without fetching its nested blocks one at a time. paste the page link, or give its title and the bot finds it. a title search can locate that reference when all you have is the document's name.

meeting-note transcripts are optional and are not included by default. ask for them only when that part of the page matters to the job. the bot should check the truncation and unrendered-block information before quoting the result as a complete account of the page.
uses: turn a named procedure into a checklist for your own use
compare the text of a revised brief with the earlier instructions you provided
read an event plan in simpler words without changing notion
include a meeting transcript in a private recap when you explicitly need it

routine.message: each tuesday at 11:50, read the notion page titled alder ferry evacuation procedure as markdown, finding the exact page first. make a checklist here from the instructions actually returned and report any truncation or blocks that could not be rendered. leave meeting transcripts out. never edit the source page or fill missing safety instructions from your own assumptions.
routine.needs: notion connection with read only access to the procedure page; title search allowed to find the page
routine.output:
alder ferry procedure: reading checklist

- gather at the marked assembly point.
- report to leontine, the coordinator named in the text.

one block could not be rendered. check that block in notion before using this as the full procedure. source page unchanged.

steps: enable notion in **Connected apps** with **read only** access for the reader bot.
paste the page reference or have it search the exact title, then confirm the page before reading.
ask the bot to state whether it received the full text and list any blocks it could not read.
once the first reading is useful, schedule the checklist and use **Pause** if the procedure moves to another page.
watch: a truncated response is not the whole page. a short summary should not conceal that the source text was incomplete.
some blocks cannot be rendered as markdown; their contents need separate inspection before you rely on the reading.
transcripts stay out unless you request their inclusion. missing transcript content is not proof no meeting notes exist.
the action retrieves text, not permission to revise the original. keep edits outside a reading routine.

faq.q: will the bot change the formatting in notion?
faq.a: this retrieves the page in a text format for the bot to read. it does not rewrite the source page.

faq.q: can it include a meeting transcript?
faq.a: yes, the action has an option to include meeting-note transcripts. ask for it explicitly because the default leaves them out.

faq.q: what if part of the page is missing?
faq.a: have the bot report truncation and unrendered blocks instead of giving a confident complete summary. inspect the gaps separately before relying on the result.
